verdict.rationale: Factory provides usage visibility—`/limits` in Droid CLI and Settings > Usage—plus per-developer/team consumption tracking and exportable reports, which lets a lead see plan-based usage. However there is no evidence of dashboards or controls to actively 'manage' daily task or concurrency limits (e.g., setting caps, adjusting quotas per team).missing for 10: admin controls to configure/adjust concurrency or daily task caps, plan-tier comparison of limits, alerts/enforcement mechanisms.
